idea-plugin.name: Entroly
idea-plugin.description:
Connect JetBrains AI Assistant to Entroly's local, open-source MCP server.

The plugin provides a guided setup action that copies a version-pinned MCP configuration and opens JetBrains's MCP settings. Entroly supplies bounded context selection, auditable receipts, exact recovery, and verification tools.

No telemetry is collected. The plugin does not silently change IDE settings, install software, or intercept model-provider traffic.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Initial release:

  • Copy a version-pinned Entroly MCP configuration.
  • Open AI Assistant MCP settings from the Tools menu.
  • Check whether the local npx runtime is available.
  • Link directly to public setup documentation and support.

action.description: Copy the Entroly MCP configuration and open AI Assistant settings
